auth.signinSubtitle: Tutors, coordinators, and admins sign in to continue.
auth.tooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

twoFactor.title: Verification Code
twoFactor.sent: We emailed a sign-in code to {email}.
twoFactor.help: Enter the 5-character code from your email.
twoFactor.invalid: That code is incorrect or expired. Request a new sign-in code.
twoFactor.unavailable: Email verification is temporarily unavailable. Contact the program team.

settings.title: Email Two-Factor Authentication
settings.description: Require a one-time email code when you sign in.
settings.featureOff: Email 2FA is disabled for this program.
settings.unavailable: Email delivery is not configured. Contact the program team.

forgot.title: Reset Your Password
forgot.intro: Enter your username or email and we'll send a reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account matches what you entered, we've sent password-reset instructions to its contact email. Check your inbox.
forgot.sentEmailNote: Email delivery isn't configured in this environment yet — see the server logs for the reset link during local development.
forgot.unavailable: Password reset email is temporarily unavailable. Contact the program team.

reset.title: Choose a New Password
reset.missingToken: This reset link is missing its token. Request a new one.
reset.success: Your password has been reset. You can sign in now.

onboarding.title: Set Up Your Account
onboarding.intro: One quick step before your dashboard — confirm your email and choose your own password (replacing any temporary one).

help.email: We'll send your sign-in verification codes here.
help.newPassword: At least 8 characters. Replaces the temporary one.

onboarding.enable2fa: Enable email two-factor authentication (recommended). A one-time code will be emailed at sign-in once email delivery is configured.

register.title: Create Your Account
register.subtitle: Use the security key an admin gave you.

code.label: Security Key
code.help: Enter the code an admin or coordinator gave you.

email.label: Email Address
email.bound: This code is tied to this email address.

done.title: You're all set!
done.body: Your account is ready. Sign in with your email or username {username}.

staleSession.title: Session Out of Date
staleSession.body: Your tutor account link is no longer valid. Sign out and sign back in to refresh it.

landing.intro: Placeholder introduction — a short paragraph about the {appTitle} program goes here. Describe who it's for, what students can get help with, and how peer tutors make a difference. Replace this copy with the real program overview.

students.title: For Students
students.body: Placeholder — sign up to be matched with a peer tutor in the subjects you choose, at times that work for you.

tutors.title: For Tutors
tutors.body: Placeholder — share what you know, build your skills, and earn service hours for every session you run.

team.title: For the Team
team.body: Placeholder — coordinate pairings, attendance, interviews, and service hours from one place.

ribbon.title: Preview
ribbon.note: You're previewing the live page. Drafts and hidden sections appear here but not to visitors.

detail.hiddenNote: This page is hidden from visitors until the section is shown.

dashboard.subtitle: Submit attendance and manage your availability.

pairings.title: My Pairings
pairings.help: Pick the default time slot for each pairing (you still enter actual session times when submitting attendance).

availability.title: My Availability
availability.help: Mark the time slots you can teach. These help coordinators schedule you.

attendance.title: Submit Attendance
attendance.help: Record a session for one of your pairings. Service hours are computed automatically.

schedule.title: Room Schedule
schedule.help: Your pairings are highlighted. Blocked cells are unavailable rooms.

pairings.title: Pairings
pairings.slotHelp: Pick a published time slot — it sets the day and time for this pairing.
pairings.subject: Subject

tutors.title: Tutors
tutors.help: A tutor's email links them to their login account at first sign-in. The username (default: first initial + last name) is an alternate sign-in identifier.
tutors.accountMovedNote: Account setup (invite links and login status) now lives on the Users & Roles page.

account.linkEmailed: Setup email sent. You can also copy the link below to share directly.
account.linkManual: Account ready. Share this setup link with the tutor (email isn't configured):

tutees.title: Tutee Roster
tutees.help: Active and inactive tutees, with their attendance and discipline standing. New public signups are handled under

requests.title: Signup Requests (Tutees)
requests.help: Public tutee signups awaiting allocation, processed earliest-first. Assign each subject choice to a tutor — that creates the pairing, and the tutor then picks the time slot.
requests.noTerm: Create a term first so requests can be assigned.
requests.banFlagTitle: Matches a tutee removed this quarter ({fields}). Vet before assigning.

readOnly.banner: Read-only access — you can browse everything but can't make changes, and contact details are hidden.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.pendingBanner: {count} tutee {count, plural, one {signup} other {signups}} awaiting review.

hours.noData: No hours logged this period yet.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Current status of every request across the program. Each item links to where you can act on it.

hero.title: Needs Attention
hero.allClear: All caught up — nothing waiting for review.

history.title: Program History
history.subtitle: Service hours and attendance for any past quarter, semester, or school year.
history.noData: No activity recorded for this period.

program.title: Program & Refresh
program.subtitle: The current period and the quarterly refresh that rolls the program over.
program.noPeriod: No active program period. Seed or create one first.
program.advancesTo: This advances the program to {name} and:
program.effectPending: Clears the pending tutee signup queue (archived to inactive).
program.effectTutees: Archives all currently paired tutees — they must sign up again to continue.
program.effectPairings: Clears the current pairings board (past pairings + attendance stay in history).
program.effectReactivate: Continuing tutors must reactivate (choose available or opt out) on their own page.
program.effectAvailability: Prompts you to confirm which active tutors are still available.
program.effectGraduate: Graduates G12 tutors (they leave at the start of Q4).
program.effectAgeUp: Advances every remaining tutor one grade.
program.effectHoursReset: Starts a fresh service-hour / attendance total for semester {semester}.
program.effectHoursKeep: Keeps service hours accumulating (still the same semester).
program.confirmLabel: Type REFRESH to confirm this program-wide action.
program.modalIntro: Confirm which active tutors are continuing. Anyone left unchecked will be archived.
program.modalGradNote: New school year: G12 tutors graduate and everyone advances a grade.

features.heading: Optional features
features.help: Switch off modules your program doesn't use. Only the head can change these, and changes take effect at the next refresh.
features.headOnly: Only the head can change these.

audit.title: Audit Log
audit.subtitle: Recent admin actions. Reversible ones can be undone here; others have a manual inverse on their own page.

users.title: Users & Roles
users.subtitle: Manage logins, roles, and tutor account setup. Role changes take effect on the user's next sign-in.
users.coordinatorHint: As a coordinator you can send setup links and change your own tutoring access. Ask an administrator to change roles.
users.confirmTransfer: Transfer leadership to {name}? You will become an admin.
users.translateDefaultHint: Admins and coordinators can always edit translations.

confirm.roleBody: Set the role of {name} to {role}? Confirm your identity to continue.
confirm.deleteBody: Permanently delete the login for {name}? Their tutor record (username, class, and history) is kept. Confirm your identity to continue.

registrationCodes.title: Registration Codes
registrationCodes.help: Issue a single-use security key for a new tutor or crew member to self-register. The code is shown once — copy it and hand it over; it is never stored.
registrationCodes.issuedHint: Copy this now — it won't be shown again.
registrationCodes.invalidNote: This code is no longer valid.

share.heading: Set up your {appTitle} account
share.setup: Set your name, grade, and a password

tutorRequests.title: Tutor Status Requests
tutorRequests.help: Tutor-initiated membership changes. Opt-out requests can only be approved after a one-week cooldown; reentry is immediate.
tutorRequests.notYet: The one-week cooldown hasn't elapsed yet.
tutorRequests.requeuePrompt: Re-queue {name}'s {count} {count, plural, one {tutee} other {tutees}} onto the signup page for reassignment?

timeslots.title: Time Slots
timeslots.description: A shared catalog of meeting times. Tutors and tutees mark availability against these; pairings can reference one. Slots are reference-only — actual session times are still entered on each attendance submission.
timeslots.label: Label

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Add classrooms and mark recurring periods when they can't be used. Blocked periods show up on the pairings room grid.

courses.title: Subjects & Levels
courses.subtitle: Subjects tutees can request. Levels are an admin-managed catalogue; a level marked “AP-scored” lets its subjects carry an AP exam score on tutor applications.

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: Difficulty tracks a subject can belong to. Mark a level AP-scored to let its subjects carry an AP exam score on tutor applications.
levels.confirmDelete: Delete level "{name}"? Its subjects keep existing but lose it.

import.empty: No subject rows found in that file.
import.formatPrefix: CSV format: one subject per line as
import.formatSuffix: (level matched by name; a header row is optional).

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.subtitle: Broadcast to tutors. Each shows on their dashboard on every login until they dismiss it; pinned ones stay visible.

policies.title: Policy Documents
policies.subtitle: Edit the tutor and tutee handbooks. Written in Markdown; the saved copy is the source of truth.
policies.empty: No policy documents yet. Run the seed to create them.
policies.confirmRemoveLanguage: Remove the {lang} version of this policy? It will be archived under version history.

adjustments.title: Tutor Hour Adjustments
adjustments.subtitle: Add extra hours or apply a punishment (deduction) to a tutor for a given month. (Tutee yellow/red cards live under Tutee discipline.)

applications.title: Tutor Applications
applications.intro: Review applicants and assign a {n}-tutor interview panel (mark one head). Click a row to expand. The head schedules the interview and records the decision from their own dashboard.
applications.head: head

cards.title: Tutee Discipline
cards.intro: Yellow/red cards issued to tutees. Recheck tutor-requested cards and flag each valid or invalid. Standing counts only valid cards (3 yellow = 1 red; 2 reds = removal-pending).
cards.standingHelp: 🟥 fills 3 slots, 🟨 fills 1 (only valid cards). A full 6 = removal pending. Click a name for the card details.

tuteeRequests.title: Opt-Outs & Removals
tuteeRequests.help: Tutee opt-outs (relayed by a tutor, with a 7-day recall window) and tutees currently removed (opted out or discipline-removed).
tuteeRequests.pendingHelp: A tutor relayed the tutee's request to leave. It auto-approves after the recall window unless the tutor recalls or you cancel it.
tuteeRequests.removedHelp: Tutees currently removed. Reinstating returns them to the signup queue for reassignment and lifts any same-quarter signup flag.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Program reports by period — general stats plus detailed entries. Print to PDF or export CSV.
reports.attendanceCaption: Present / excused / unexcused = tutee attendance across sessions.

crew.title: Crew
crew.subtitle: Set the order the crew walks the rooms, and choose who's on the crew.
crew.orderHelp: Rooms are visited top to bottom. Use the arrows to reorder.
crew.noRooms: No rooms yet. Add rooms first.
crew.deleteConfirm: Delete the crew account for {name}? This cannot be undone.
crew.issuedHint: Codes handed to accepted applicants, awaiting registration. Revoking a code on Registration Codes returns its application to the queue above.

sessionFlags.title: Attendance Flags
sessionFlags.help: The crew counted fewer students than the tutor marked present. Review each and decide.

landing.title: Landing Page
landing.subtitle: Edit what visitors see on the public home page — text, program news, and images. Changes go live immediately.
landing.appTitleHint: Use {appTitle} to insert the program name.

heroImage.uploadFirst: Upload an image first in the Images tab.

upload.title: Upload an Image
upload.hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, up to 2 MB.

images.confirmDelete: Delete this image? Any post using it will show a broken image.

hero.title: Top of Page
hero.desc: The headline, tagline, intro, and image visitors see first.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.desc: The two action buttons in the top section.

features.title: Highlights
features.desc: The three cards that highlight the program.

footer.title: Footer
footer.desc: The small print at the bottom of the page.

layout.title: Page Layout
layout.subtitle: Arrange, add, and remove the blocks that make up the page. Check your changes with Preview.
layout.empty: No blocks yet. Add one below.
layout.systemHint: Edit its content in the {tab} tab.

tabDesc.layout: Arrange the blocks that make up the landing page.
tabDesc.content: The hero, buttons, feature cards and footer text.
tabDesc.sections: Expandable panels and their detail pages.
tabDesc.pages: Standalone pages at /p/… for the nav menu or links.
tabDesc.images: Upload and manage images used across the page.

activate.title: Confirm Your Availability
activate.body: A new term has started. Activate your account to keep tutoring, or opt out for now.
activate.note: You can change this later from your settings.

meetings.title: Upcoming Meetings
meetings.help: Can't make a meeting? Excuse your absence up to 30 minutes before it starts.

handbook.empty: The handbook hasn't been published yet.

attendance.noPairings: You have no pairings yet. Ask an admin to set one up.
attendance.mergeTitle: Merge Other Sessions into This Block
attendance.mergeHelp: Running several subjects together? Tick the other pairings covered in this same time block. Each is recorded separately, but the block's service hours are counted once.
attendance.mergedNote: Merged sessions share this block's time and ratings. Hours are credited once, on the primary session.
attendance.mergedCount: {count} other session(s) merged into this block (set under My pairings).
attendance.cardsHelp: Assign a yellow or red card with a brief reason. The team rechecks each before it counts. (An unexcused absence above auto-issues a red card.)

errors.absenceReason: Give a reason for the tutor absence.
errors.excusedReason: Give a reason for each excused absence.
errors.ratingsRequired: Ratings are required for a held session.
errors.cardReason: Add a reason for each card you assign.

attendance.roomHelp: Pick the room you actually used so crew checks line up. Choose “Held Online” if the session wasn't in a room.

pairings.empty: No pairings yet. A coordinator will assign you tutees.
pairings.mergeHelp: Running these together in one block? Tick the sessions covered alongside the one selected in the attendance form. Each is recorded separately, but the block's service hours count once.
pairings.mergeSelectPrimary: Select a session in the attendance form to merge others into it.
pairings.mergeNone: No other session shares a tutee or subject with the selected one.
pairings.removalHelp: The tutee asked to leave? Relay their opt-out. There's a 7-day window where you (or an admin) can recall it; after that it's automatic.

availability.empty: No time slots have been published yet.

interviews.help: Applicants you're on the panel for. Cast your vote after the demo; the head records the final decision.
interviews.majorityTie: tie — cast your vote to break it
interviews.tally: Tally: {accepts} accept · {rejects} reject (majority: {majority}). Record the final decision with a brief comment.
interviews.awaitingSchedule: Awaiting the head to schedule a time.

settings.title: Account Settings
settings.subtitle: Update your personal information and password.
settings.name: Name
settings.gradeHelp: Self-report your current grade (e.g. if you repeated a year). Your class-of year follows from this.
settings.altNamesHelp: Shown alongside your name (e.g. your name in another script).
settings.emailHelp: Where sign-in and password-reset emails are sent.
settings.pwTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters.
settings.optOutHelp: Leaving the program? Submit an opt-out request. An admin can process it after a one-week cooldown, during which you can recall it.
settings.optOutPending: Opt-out requested. An admin can approve it after {date}. You can recall it until then.
settings.reentryPending: Reentry requested and awaiting an admin's approval.
settings.reentryHelp: Want to rejoin the program? Request reentry and an admin will review it.
settings.statusNote: Your tutor status is {status}. This is read-only access — contact an admin for changes.

pending.title: Your Tutor Account Is Pending Approval
pending.body: A coordinator will activate your account shortly. In the meantime you can set the time slots you're available for below.

inactive.title: Read-Only Access
inactive.body: Your tutor account is {status}. You can view your history but can't submit attendance or take on new tutees.
inactive.reentryHint: Want to come back? Request reentry from your account settings.

availability.title: My Availability
availability.help: Mark the time slots you can teach.

discipline.title: Tutee Conduct
discipline.help: Card standing for your tutees. The team keeps the specific reasons.

signup.title: Request a Peer Tutor
signup.intro: Tell us what you'd like help with and when you're free. A coordinator will review your request and match you with a tutor.
signup.successBody: Thanks, {name}. A coordinator will review your request and be in touch about your tutor and schedule.

placeholders.preferredContact: e.g. text me at 555-123-4567, or email me (best after 4pm)

help.preferredContact: Tell us the best way and time to contact you about your tutoring match.

signup.noSlots: No time slots are published yet. Please check back later.
signup.agree: I have read and agree to abide by the <policy>{appTitle} Policy</policy>.

tutorSignup.title: Apply to Become a Peer Tutor
tutorSignup.intro: Tell us which subjects you'd like to tutor. The coordinator team reviews every application and arranges an interview before you join.
tutorSignup.successBody: Thanks, {name}. The coordinator team will review your application and arrange an interview. We'll reach you at {email}.

fields.courses: Subjects you want to tutor (up to 3) *
fields.selfStudyNote: How do you qualify / what have you achieved?

placeholders.preferredContact: e.g. text me at 555-123-4567, or email me (best after 4pm)
placeholders.selfStudyNote: e.g. completed an online class, competition results, portfolio…

help.preferredContact: The best way and time to reach you about your application and interview.

tutorSignup.coursesHelp: For each, tell us how you're qualified: whether you've taken the class, hold an AP score (AP subjects only), and/or self-studied it.
tutorSignup.agree: I have read and agree to abide by the <policy>{appTitle} Policy</policy>.

policy.mustRead: Open and read the policy to the end before agreeing.
policy.scrollPrompt: Scroll to the end to continue.

crewSignup.title: Join the Crew
crewSignup.intro: The crew walks the rooms and records headcounts to validate attendance. Apply below — an admin will review and send you a code.
crewSignup.doneBody: Thanks! An admin will review your application and email you a registration code if accepted.

viewerSignup.title: Follow the Program
viewerSignup.intro: Create a free read-only account to follow the program. Parents, faculty, and community members are welcome — you'll see the same overview the team does, with personal details hidden.
viewerSignup.doneBody: Your read-only account is ready. You can sign in with your email now.

fields.name: Your Name

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Manage your login name and password.
account.tutorNote: You also have a tutor account.

password.twoFactorHint: For your security, we'll email a verification code before your password changes.

patrol.title: Room Patrol
patrol.subtitle: Walk the rooms in order and tap how many students are in each. Submitting a sweep credits 0.5 service hours.

optedOut.body: You can request to rejoin anytime.
